verdict.rationale: Swell documents serverless functions that run on its own edge infrastructure to customize logic. App models can declare validation and lifecycle events, so the core of in-platform custom backend logic is first-party. However, nothing shows functions hooking into discount calculation or shipping-rate rules specifically, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented function hooks for discount and shipping-rule logic, details on which platform events or triggers functions can intercept, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject custom backend logic — discounts, shipping rules, validation — as serverless functions or hooks that run inside the platform

citations.quote: Deploy serverless functions to customize logic and connect to external APIs.
Functions are deployed to edge data centers in 200+ locations and have no cold start time.
Drop a JSON file into your app’s models/ directory and Swell generates the REST resource from it—fields, validation, relationships and lifecycle events, with no endpoint code to write.
